impact: Shows an end-to-end data-engineering workflow where research discovery becomes validated, auditable, repeatable acquisition instead of a pile of links.

title: AI in Education: from sentiment project to evidence system
summary: Expanded R-001 into a multi-layer research system combining a 23,218-response student survey, U.S. educator evidence, Census business AI adoption, O*NET/OpenAI exposure data, and BLS employment and wage outcomes.
impact: Shows an evidence-first analytical workflow that keeps attitudes, measurable outcomes, competing hypotheses, and causal attribution separate until the data support a conclusion.
